name: How often should I replace the filters in my reverse osmosis system?

mainEntity.name: How often should I replace the filters in my reverse osmosis system?

acceptedAnswer.text: The frequency of reverse osmosis (RO) filter replacement depends on your water quality and usage. Typically, pre-filters (sediment and carbon) should be changed every 6-12 months, and the post-carbon filter every 12 months. The RO membrane, which is the core of the system, usually lasts 2-5 years. In areas like Las Vegas with hard water, regular maintenance helps prevent mineral buildup that can shorten filter life. Consistent filter changes ensure your system continues to provide clean, great-tasting water efficiently.
